prompt: "Write a behavior tree for the robot to execute the command using only available nodes. If object is reached then grab it, check its properties, move to destination, and perform task. If object is visible then approach it. list of available nodes: <Action ID = TakeObject    /> <Action ID = MoveToDestination    /> <Condition ID = IsObjectApproached    /> <Action ID = ApproachObject    /> <Action ID = ScanAreaForObject    /> <Action ID = ScanAreaForDestination    /> <Action ID = CheckObjectProperties    /> <Action ID = PerformTask    />"
code:
SEQUENCE
			IF IsObjectApproached? THEN
			DO TakeObject
	ELSE
		DO CheckObjectProperties
		DO MoveToDestination
		DO PerformTask
	END
